name: Bauernhof Friedl
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Friedl is located in Pfafflar, Tyrol, tucked away in an untouched Alpine side valley. The holiday apartments are furnished in a rustic, functional style, ensuring comfort and authentic character. This peaceful lodging serves as a prime base for mountaineering and hiking tours into the Lechtal Alps. Pfafflar is an idyllic mountain hamlet free from through-traffic, allowing guests to completely immerse themselves in the quiet majesty of nature. Fresh regional delicacies produced directly on the farm are also available. The breathtaking surroundings are renowned for rewarding summer treks and pristine winter ski touring.
